name: Josef Gregorian
summary: In the Undercity’s Magic Quarter, Josef Gregorian trains tailors of the Horde. His skill guides them toward enchanted fabrics and specialized garments.

sections.title: Weaver of the Magic Quarter
sections.body: Josef Gregorian teaches tailoring in the Undercity’s Magic Quarter, where Forsaken and their Horde allies practice the craft. Tailoring remains vital to warlocks, mages, and priests who channel raw energies through woven fibers. Gregorian teaches foundational patterns and stitches the first robes for young mages who bring him the right materials.

faq.q: Where can I find Josef Gregorian?
faq.answer: Josef Gregorian works and teaches in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity, among the city’s casters and scholars.

faq.q: What role does Josef Gregorian serve in the Undercity?
faq.answer: Josef Gregorian trains Horde crafters in sewing patterns and techniques. He also stitches the first robes for young mages sent to him by Anastasia Hartwell.

faq.q: What quests does Josef Gregorian offer?
faq.answer: Anastasia Hartwell sends young mages to Josef Gregorian with linen cloth and Dalaran mana gems taken in Silverpine. He uses the materials to stitch them a set of Lesser Spellfire Robes.

angles.text: For Horde clothiers, Josef Gregorian is a tailoring instructor in Lordaeron who also stitches robes for young mages who bring him the materials.
As an undead tailor, Josef Gregorian carries on the delicate art of human tailoring, which survived Lordaeron’s fall and now serves Forsaken society.
